suite: annotate bind form (a drag keeps the pick, the ends by name, the leader)
expect_red: after one Bind the form shows that end as taken and the other preselected -- and the end it was written at is the one chosen

mutations.contract: The event the form writes stores the end the reader chose.
mutations.note: Writes every bind at the second end whatever was chosen -- the wrong-end event again, this time behind a correct-looking form. Since 2026-11-13 (a_feature_is_bound_once_to_a_set_of_faces, review round 1) the form writes a feature-keyed event, so the wrong end is the feature computed from the second end.
